title: SMTO-LLM-0042 — The model replied in a format SMTO can't read

html:
SMTO-LLM-0042 — The model replied in a format SMTO can't read

GUID: 6e64457a-07a4-4928-ae4f-29c1865db803
Slug: unsupported-assistant-content
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: llm

What happened

  • The model sent its reply in a form other than plain text, such as an image or an unknown block, which this model connection doesn't accept. SMTO didn't act on that reply.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Wait to see whether the Run continues. SMTO may ask the model once more by itself after a reply it can't use. The model may answer in plain text on its next try.
  2. If the Run stopped, read its activity in the conversation to see which steps already finished, then ask the Agent to continue only the rest. SMTO ignored the unreadable reply, but steps before it already happened. Repeating them could do the same work twice.
  3. If it keeps happening, choose a different model in Settings › Setup › Model routing, or ask the person who runs the model server to check this model's chat template. Some model setups package replies in ways this connection doesn't support.

What success looks like

  • The Run continues past this step, and the Agent's next action appears in its activity.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who runs the model server or manages SMTO. Don't ask the Agent to redo steps that already finished.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The assistant message content is not a string, null, or a list made only of text/output_text parts, so it cannot be converted into the negotiated message format.

What this means

  • Assistant content must use supported text or text-part representations; a different content shape cannot be converted into the negotiated message format. This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • Assistant content must use supported text or text-part representations; a different content shape cannot be converted into the negotiated message format.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the content type with the negotiated text protocol and serving template; verify whether the producer emitted unsupported multimodal parts.

How to fix it

  • Raised by text_content in src/agent_runtime/llm/openai_compat/response.py and checked again by validate_envelope in native_protocol.py. Inspect choices[0].message.content in the trace and serve a model and chat template that return text content through the OpenAI-compatible chat API; do not loosen protocol validation or change tool permissions.
  • Use a supported served model/chat template and its advertised content encoding. Inspect safe protocol diagnostics without changing tool authorization.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A response using supported text content passes message normalization and envelope validation.

What not to do

  • Do not replay prior successful operations to repair a later model response.
  • Do not disable protocol validation or treat this representation failure as input-context overflow.

Technical notes

  • This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
